Morse Private Messenger
Message privately without a phone number, ads, or tracking
Morse Messenger is a private messaging service that lets you chat without sharing your phone number or email. You create a Morse ID, connect intentionally, and keep messages, media, and calls end-to-end encrypted so only participants can read or hear them. It avoids address-book uploads, public directories, and ads, and runs over Wi-Fi without a SIM card. Funded by a simple annual subscription, Morse aligns its business model with user privacy and keeps conversations secure and discreet.

Meditation app that writes and narrates sessions for your moment
Sit is a meditation app with no library. Tell it what's on your mind in a sentence or a single word, and it writes and narrates a guided meditation for that moment in seconds. You choose the length, one of eight styles, how much guidance you want, a voice, and a soundscape. Every session is new; nothing is pre-recorded.
Sit is generated natively in 12 languages, never translated or dubbed. The free tier gives you one new session a day, up to 20 minutes, with no card and no trial clock. DeedSpring
AI transaction coordinator for real estate
DeedSpring is AI transaction coordination software for US real estate agents, teams, transaction coordinators, and brokerages. It reads executed contracts, pulls every date, follows up with lenders, title companies, and signatures, and keeps buyers and sellers updated in a branded client portal. Documents and e-signing are built in. Pricing starts at $15 per month per closing.
